findings.issue: The description claims 'the exact ReductiveGroups/README.md Layer 9 target "Root subgroup maps: x_α : 𝔾_a → G"'. That target's stated earlier stages are all absent: README lines 245-258 order Layer 9 as split reductive group schemes over ℤ → pinnings → the Chevalley–Demazure construction → base change → root subgroup maps, and none of the first four exist. Accepting the author's parallel-lanes and worked-examples quotes (README lines 85, 273-281) does not rescue the Layer 9 claim: those authorize an SLₙ lane, not a Layer 9 deliverable. I am not asking this PR to build the uniform pinned interface — only to stop claiming the Layer 9 target.

findings.issue: The stated consumer edge ('CFSGStatement L0 → ReductiveGroups Layer 9 root subgroup maps; this PR supplies the determinant-one type-A specialization used by the simply connected A-family') is not supported. CFSG L0 consumes the pinned Chevalley–Demazure group scheme over ℤ, its base change, its 𝔽̄_p-points and the root subgroups of that group; it does not consume an SLₙ-specific map, and cannot use one without the pinned scheme it is defined against.

summary: Single topic is satisfied, but the cited Layer 9 root-subgroup target presupposes Layer 9 stages (split reductive group schemes over ℤ, pinnings, the Chevalley–Demazure construction, base change) that exist neither on main nor in an open PR, and the SLₙ transvection map is a second satellite around a target no statement of which gets closer.
